ED Conducts Raids Across Multiple States in Various Cases

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has conducted raids at multiple locations across several Indian states, including West Bengal, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Rajasthan, and the Delhi-NCR region. The investigations reportedly involve alleged terror funding, illegal infiltration, and money laundering linked to illegal sand mining. Some reports indicate cash seizures were made during these operations.
